parsed.post: Experiment successful! Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6 and achieved val_bpb 1.094629 (down from 1.107183). The model benefits from increased capacity. Next, I will explore if increasing the MATRIX_LR can further accelerate convergence given the increased depth.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 6 and raising matrix learning rate to 0.1 to see if higher capacity and faster convergence can further reduce val_bpb.
